institution.name: Academy for Nursing and Health Occupations

plan.notes: Source: Academy for Nursing and Health Occupations official website, 'Practical Nursing Including IV Skills and Critical Thinking' program page, hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Award as printed: 'Occupational Associate Degree' (abbreviated OAD here). Stated program totals: 64 weeks, 74 credit hours. The 10 listed courses sum to exactly 74 using the catalog's detailed theory/lab/clinical breakdowns (the companion AS-page header prints a rounded '11' for PRN0690D; the Occupational page itself prints the precise 10.89, which is used). Catalog does NOT publish a term-by-term map; the program is described as linear ('no Prerequisite required prior to entering the Practical Nursing Program... all courses... are linear in nature'), so the 5 terms below are an editorial sequencing derived strictly from the catalog's prerequisite chains. Prereqs transcribed from the catalog's Prerequisite Courses lists. CATALOG TYPO: this page states PRN0690D must be passed 'in order to apply for the NCLEX-RN Exam' - the parallel Associate of Science in Practical Nursing page correctly states NCLEX-PN for this practical-nursing program; recorded as printed with this flag. This program has no general-education courses (unlike the 80-week/90-credit AS in Practical Nursing).

courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'PRN0098A(Th) / PRN0098A/L (Lab) Basic Skills: 5.07 Semester Credit hrs'. Theory 3.8 + Lab 1.27. Th and Lab are corequisites. Completion qualifies a student to sit for the Florida CNA exam.
courses.title: Basic Skills

courses.title: Nursing Process & Geriatric Nursing
